info.title: Career NLP Asset
info.description: Reusable NLP component for Placement & Career Intelligence: extraction, classification, embeddings, matching, recommendation and retrieval - with structured output and confidence scores.

post.description: JD PROVIDED: student text vs. one job description.
JD NOT PROVIDED: best job(s) from the full job dataset.
Single entry point: runs match if job_text is given, else recommend.

job_text.title: Job Text
job_text.description: If omitted, the recommendation flow is used.

factors.title: Factors
factors.description: Per-factor breakdown. Only populated when include_details=true.

Confidence.title: Confidence
Confidence.description:
Confidence attached to a result.

``score`` is in [0, 1]. For classification it is the model's predicted
probability. For matching/recommendation it is an *evidence-sufficiency*
heuristic (how much signal the result rests on) - it is NOT a calibrated
probability that the answer is correct. ``calibrated`` says which it is.
